job_description:
• Manage and maintain the company's IT infrastructure, including servers, networks, workstations, and end-user devices.
• Install, configure, and support Windows Server, Microsoft 365, and business applications.
• Monitor system performance and ensure the availability, reliability, and security of IT services.
• Administer Active Directory, user accounts, email services, permissions, and access controls.
• Configure and maintain network infrastructure, including switches, routers, Wi-Fi, firewalls, and VPN connectivity.
• Administer and support the company's Odoo ERP system, including user management, system configuration, troubleshooting, and coordination with external vendors.
• Provide technical support to Odoo ERP users and ensure the system operates efficiently to support business operations.
• Perform system backups and ensure disaster recovery and business continuity procedures are in place.
• Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, network, and connectivity issues.
• Provide technical support to employees and deliver excellent IT services across the organization.
• Manage IT assets, software licenses, and inventory.
• Coordinate with external IT vendors and service providers when required.
• Maintain accurate documentation of IT systems, procedures, and configurations.
• Support IT projects, infrastructure upgrades, and future technology initiatives

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field.
• 3-5 years of experience as an IT System Administrator or in a similar role.
• Strong knowledge of Windows Server, Microsoft 365, Active Directory, and networking.
• Hands-on experience with Odoo ERP administration and user support.
• Experience with virtualization technologies (VMware or Hyper-V) is preferred.
• Knowledge of cloud platforms (Microsoft Azure or AWS) is an advantage.
• Strong troubleshooting, communication, and problem-solving skills.
• Relevant certifications (Microsoft, Cisco, VMware, or CompTIA) are a plus

Benefits

• Opportunity to join a fast-growing organization
• Professional development and career growth opportunities
• Collaborative and dynamic work environment
